policy.allocation: Bernoullis in fair order stop at max successes. Top up to min in that order, first recipients without success, cycle only when min exceeds recipient count. Pool choices occur after row recipient allocation, uniformly over sorted linked IDs. Duplicates are retained.
policy.delivery: Allocation plans are pending entitlements, not committed drops. Native packing, transient capacity, durable ownership/pickup and once-only commit are coordinator obligations; insufficient capacity must not reroll.
policy.independence: Each source row, including identical repeats, is separate; never merge eligibility, ownership, source or min/max.
policy.probability_labels: Attempt-item probabilities are before min/max and are not final per-character probabilities. Final chance is deliberately not projected by this context-free endpoint.
policy.qualification: Recovered Release 7.0 literal XML rows, strict selected 123.5.1 properties; allocation/public-gate/RNG law is authored, not authenticated historical engine behavior.
policy.recipient_order: Sort eligible durable character IDs, then reverse Fisher-Yates with unbiased bounded indices, independently per row. Public uses one virtual recipient.
policy.rng: p=0/p=1 need no unit draw; max=0, p=0 with min=0, no eligible private character and failed public gate need no row draws. Singleton permutation/pool choices need no index draw. u < p succeeds; equality fails.
